statement_alignment: The source asserts infinitely many even n with prime derangement number D_n. evenPrimeDerangementIndices is exactly the set of n satisfying Even n and primality of Fintype.card (derangements (Fin n)), Mathlib's actual fixed-point-free permutation subtype. The all-even theorem proves each member condition false; the next two advertised theorems prove the exact set is empty and hence not Set.Infinite. The parenthetical parity remark about odd D_n is contextual and is not a premise or conclusion of this package.
formal_scope: Lean 4.33.1 plus Mathlib v4.33.1 proves non-primality for every even derangement cardinality, explicitly including D_0, D_2, and the recurrence factorization for n >= 4, then bridges that conclusion to emptiness and non-infinitude of the source-defined index set.
